title: Eve of the Emperor Penguin
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to icy Antarctica to find the fourth secret of happiness. Deep inside a glowing ice cavern, they meet a royal emperor penguin and a brave little orphan who changes everything! 🐧

q.en: What cold continent do Jack and Annie travel to in this story?
q.zh: 在这个故事里，杰克和安妮去了哪个寒冷的大陆？

options.en: Australia, though that is another story

explain.en: Jack and Annie are sent to Antarctica, where they explore Mount Erebus and meet the emperor penguins.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮被派往南极洲，在那里他们探索了埃里伯斯火山，并遇见了帝企鹅。

q.en: What is the 'burning mountain of ice and snow' that they climb?
q.zh: 他们攀登的那座“冰雪中的燃烧之山”是哪座山？

options.zh: 拉什莫尔山，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Mount Erebus is the volcano in Antarctica with a lake of boiling lava, called the 'burning mountain of ice and snow.'
explain.zh: 埃里伯斯火山是南极洲的一座火山，山顶有一个沸腾的熔岩湖，被称为“冰雪中的燃烧之山”。

q.en: What are the 'lava bombs' that Ali warns them about?
q.zh: 阿里警告他们的“熔岩炸弹”到底是什么？

options.en: Hard snowballs thrown by the wind
options.zh: 被风抛起的硬雪球，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: Blobs of fiery hot liquid rock

explain.en: Ali explains that lava bombs are blobs of fiery hot liquid rock spat from the crater; some can be as big as a car.
explain.zh: 阿里解释说，熔岩炸弹是从火山口喷出的炽热液态岩浆团块，有些能像汽车一样大。

q.en: Why does Jack feel dizzy and sick while on the mountain?
q.zh: 杰克在山上为什么会感到头晕、不舒服？

explain.en: High on Mount Erebus, Jack feels the room spinning and says, 'I think I've got altitude sickness.'
explain.zh: 在埃里伯斯火山高处，杰克感到屋子在旋转，他说：“我想我得了高原反应。”

q.en: What carries Jack and Annie through the dark tunnel to the Cave of the Ancient Crown?
q.zh: 是什么载着杰克和安妮穿过黑暗隧道，来到“远古王冠之洞”的？

options.en: A spinning helicopter, though that is another story

explain.en: After falling into a hole, Jack and Annie ride a slab of ice down a narrow river and slip out into the glowing cavern.
explain.zh: 掉进洞里后，杰克和安妮乘着一块冰块沿狭窄的河流漂下，滑入那座发光的洞穴。

q.en: What does the emperor penguin wear that shows he is royal?
q.zh: 那只帝企鹅戴着什么，显示出他的王者身份？

options.zh: 一副圆框眼镜，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: When their ice raft reaches the ledge, Jack sees the penguin wearing a glittering crown — the ancient crown they were sent to find.
explain.zh: 当他们的冰块漂到岩架边时，杰克看到那只企鹅戴着一顶闪闪发光的王冠——也就是他们奉命要找的远古王冠。

q.en: Who gives the little orphan penguin the name 'Penny'?
q.zh: 是谁给那只小孤儿企鹅起了“佩妮”这个名字？

explain.en: Jack pats the baby's head and says 'Thanks, Penny.' Annie giggles because usually she is the one who names the animals.
explain.zh: 杰克拍了拍小企鹅的头说“谢谢你，佩妮”。安妮咯咯笑，因为平时都是她给动物起名字。

q.en: What secret of happiness is connected to the nautilus shell from the deep ocean?
q.zh: 从深海带回的鹦鹉螺壳，代表了哪一种幸福的秘密？

options.en: Having compassion for all living things
options.zh: 对所有生命怀有怜悯之心

options.en: Paying attention to small things in nature
options.zh: 留意大自然中的细微事物
赢下你参加的每个比赛

explain.en: Annie tells Merlin the shell teaches that happiness comes from having compassion for all living things, from a tiny shell creature to a giant octopus.
explain.zh: 安妮告诉梅林，这只壳教会我们：幸福来自对所有生命的怜悯，从微小的壳中生物到巨大的章鱼。

q.en: What is the fourth secret of happiness Jack and Annie learn in Antarctica?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在南极学到的第四个幸福秘密是什么？

options.en: Collect as many shells as possible
Win a contest against a friend

options.zh: 去遥远的冰封之地旅行

options.en: Take care of someone who needs you

explain.en: Morgan explains the fourth secret: taking loving care of another can make one very happy, because it helps us look outside ourselves.
explain.zh: 摩根解释了第四个秘密：关爱地照顾他人能让人非常幸福，因为这能帮我们把目光放到自己之外。

q.en: Mount Erebus was named after a god from which mythology?
q.zh: 埃里伯斯火山是以哪个神话体系中的神命名的？

explain.en: The book says Mount Erebus was named after Erebus, a god from Greek mythology who was the son of Chaos and the god of darkness.
explain.zh: 书里说，埃里伯斯火山以希腊神话中的神“厄瑞玻斯”命名，他是混沌之子，也是黑暗之神。
